identity.claim_boundary: This profile is a deterministic, paper-guided reconstruction. It is not the unavailable author-pretrained FQFODE policy and must not be reported as an exact reproduction of the paper results.

q_learning.reward: At generation k>=7, after choosing the generation-k action: 100*(f_(k-1)-f_(k-2))/(1-f_(k-1)+1e-12).

offline_training.stage_initialization: Algorithm 2 produces one aggregated Qinit. The same Qinit is copied into each of the four formal stage tables, which then update independently online.
offline_training.aggregation: element-wise arithmetic mean over the five final agent tables
offline_training.environment_completion: One interaction executes one complete generation through the audited FODE core on the declared fixed training case WS2tn50. WS2tn50 belongs to the paper's WS2 and 50-turbine experimental family and avoids the all-zero reward degeneracy observed on sparse single-direction WS1tn10. The exact author pretraining case is not published.
offline_training.starting_state_completion: Each round uses the predefined a=0.8 starting state allowed by Algorithm 2 line 8.
offline_training.training_reward_completion: Algorithm 2 does not define its environment reward numerically. After each complete training generation, this profile applies Equation 21 to the improvement caused by that interaction: 100*(f_after-f_before)/(1-f_after+1e-12).
offline_training.physical_fes: Every complete layout evaluated during artifact training is counted and stored in the artifact metadata. It is separate from formal optimization physical_fes.
offline_training.artifact_integrity: FNV-1a-64 over the IEEE-754 bytes of the four 101x3 tables; load rejects a training-case-ID mismatch, an all-zero table set, or a hash mismatch. Every formal case loads this one shared artifact.

learned_method_receipt.initialization: five zero Q-tables; predefined fractional order a=0.8 at each round
learned_method_receipt.epochs_or_steps: 5 agents x 4 inherited rounds x 101 complete FODE generations
learned_method_receipt.inference_physical_fes: per formal run request; offline work remains separate
learned_method_receipt.learned_state_origin: declared deterministic reconstruction; no author Q-table was released

independent_stage_sensitivity_receipt.claim_boundary: Sensitivity-only alternative generated by training all four stage tables independently; never pooled with the baseline.

formal_optimization.formal_physical_fes: The requested formal budget, including 24000 for the paper protocol, is consumed entirely by formal layout evaluations. Offline training is not subtracted from this budget.

paper_internal_conflicts.conflict: Algorithm 3 uses a <- a + delta_a; Equation 24 uses a <- a + a*delta_a.
paper_internal_conflicts.rationale: The 101-state grid and fixed +/-0.01 actions jointly support the additive transition.
paper_internal_conflicts.main_result_scope: The sensitivity profile is outside the main reconstruction result.

paper_internal_conflicts.conflict: The paper specifies 200 generations and a 24000-FES stopping budget without publishing the executable mapping.

paper_internal_conflicts.rationale: The main profile gives priority to the complete Algorithm 2 plus Algorithm 3/Table 3 executable sequence.
